problem_text:
A manufacturing network aims to devise a strategy for curbing material waste from several production lines. Initially, no waste-reduction techniques are in place.

The baseline characteristics for each production line are as follows:
* For Line 1, waste coefficient is 1.172, output volume is 194.163.
* For Line 2, waste coefficient is 2.716, output volume is 69.268.
* For Line 3, waste coefficient is 2.429, output volume is 163.799.
* For Line 4, waste coefficient is 0.573, output volume is 140.031.
* For Line 5, waste coefficient is 2.518, output volume is 174.903.
* For Line 6, waste coefficient is 1.18, output volume is 191.722.
* For Line 7, waste coefficient is 0.66, output volume is 141.922.
* For Line 8, waste coefficient is 2.281, output volume is 113.779.

To mitigate waste, several recycling and process improvement techniques are available, each with a specific waste recovery rate:
* Technique1 recovers 82% of the material waste.
* Technique2 recovers 44% of the material waste.
* Technique3 recovers 32% of the material waste.
* Technique4 recovers 72% of the material waste.
* Technique5 recovers 49% of the material waste.
* Technique6 recovers 86% of the material waste.
* Technique7 recovers 21% of the material waste.
* Technique8 recovers 70% of the material waste.

Implementing a technique on a production line incurs an incremental cost per unit of output volume. The cost matrix for all line–technique pairings is provided below:

| Line \ Technique | Technique1 | Technique2 | Technique3 | Technique4 | Technique5 | Technique6 | Technique7 | Technique8 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Line 1 | 99.635 | 82.766 | 38.516 | 186.92 | 172.922 | 115.044 | 183.65 | 150.727 |
| Line 2 | 89.68 | 71.142 | 89.089 | 146.855 | 61.539 | 24.799 | 80.834 | 105.388 |
| Line 3 | 181.369 | 44.075 | 162.824 | 196.469 | 191.275 | 23.096 | 98.368 | 63.638 |
| Line 4 | 170.521 | 72.187 | 115.087 | 11.514 | 48.128 | 117.123 | 67.743 | 128.316 |
| Line 5 | 98.146 | 122.421 | 103.739 | 156.797 | 47.13 | 181.084 | 154.492 | 56.574 |
| Line 6 | 11.212 | 87.907 | 54.27 | 75.821 | 169.519 | 176.668 | 190.688 | 10.278 |
| Line 7 | 134.888 | 171.311 | 148.171 | 29.75 | 110.665 | 55.252 | 103.485 | 21.38 |
| Line 8 | 199.422 | 145.214 | 27.675 | 185.042 | 180.485 | 108.754 | 143.161 | 80.773 |

The network must decide which techniques to apply to each line (lines may adopt multiple techniques concurrently), and a line may also remain partially untreated if required. The objective is to guarantee that the total material waste is reduced by at least a fraction P = 0.687 of the baseline amount, while minimizing the aggregate implementation cost.
